name: HUSHABY BABY
source:
In this game you had a girlfriend who died in a train accident about a month ago. One day, when you are going back to your home, you found her waiting at the door! The story starts from there and last for several days as you accompany her through the last days before the 49th day after she died...

[From [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=382&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
在本作中，你的女友约在一个月前不幸死于一场电车事故。某天当你回到家时，竟惊讶地发现她正站在门前等候着你！故事便由此展开——在她离世后的“四十九日”到来之前，你将陪伴她走过留在人世的最后几天时光……

[摘自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=382&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
